abstract: OBJECTIVE: To investigate the methods of fertility-sparing therapy for patients with placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) and analyze the outcomes. METHODS: From January 1999 to October 2010, the clinical features, pathology, diagnosis, fertility-preserving treatment, and outcomes of 6 patients with PSTT were studied retrospectively. Six patients were provided with multimodality treatment, which combined with surgery and chemotherapy. Five patients had received intrauterine arterial infusion chemotherapy. Three patients with polypoid-type tumor were treated by dilation and curettage and combination chemotherapy. Three patients with nodular masses underwent uterine tumor resection and combination chemotherapy. Two patients with nodular masses were treated by combination chemotherapy after dilation and curettage, and then uterine tumor resection was performed. RESULTS: After follow-up for 10 to 104 months (mean, 47 months), 6 patients achieved a complete remission, presented no signs of recurrence, and had restored normal menstruation. One of them had a normal delivery in July 2011. CONCLUSIONS: Fertility-conserving therapy for young women with PSTT would be practicable if the patient is younger than 35 years, strongly desires to preserve fertility and responds well to chemotherapy and conservative surgery, the pathological results of which do not show poor prognostic factors and the gross pathologic type does not present markedly enlarged uterus, diffuse infiltrative and diffuse multifocal disease within the uterus.
abstract_ja: 目的：胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)患者に対する妊孕性温存療法の方法を検討し、その成績を解析すること。方法：1999年1月から2010年10月までに、PSTT患者6例の臨床的特徴、病理組織学的所見、診断、妊孕性温存治療および転帰を後方視的に検討した。6例は手術と化学療法を組み合わせた治療を受けた。5例は子宮内動脈注入化学療法を受けた。ポリープ型腫瘍の3例は、掻爬術と併用化学療法で治療された。結節状腫瘤の3例は子宮腫瘍切除術と併用化学療法を受けた。結節状腫瘤の2例は、掻爬術後に併用化学療法を行い、その後子宮腫瘍切除術を施行した。結果：10～104か月(平均47か月)のフォローアップ後、6例全例が完全寛解に達し、再発の徴候はなく、正常な月経が回復した。そのうち1例は2011年7月に正常分娩に至った。結論：若年女性のPSTTに対する妊孕性温存療法は、患者が35歳未満で、強く妊孕性の温存を希望し、化学療法と保存的手術によく反応し、病理組織学的結果に予後不良因子がなく、肉眼的病型で子宮の著明な腫大、子宮内のびまん性浸潤性病変やびまん性多発病変を示さない場合に、実施可能と考えられる。
